mechanics.summary: Highland Cattle graze at Berry Bushes and produce 30 food per minute each while eating, without depleting the bush and without villagers or drop-off. One cow per bush. Trained at Tower Houses (75 food, 25 gold, 25 s); not counted in population. Capacity 9, +4 per Highland landmark. One starts with the player.
evidence: jeando17:highland_cattle_sco#description ("produce Food at a rate of 30 per minute ... capacity of 9 ... increases by 4 with every Highland Landmark")
transcript:c_oaynL66jY@5:16-5:43 ("Can they eat on the same one? No ... They do not consume the berries ... six berries ... 180 food per minute")
transcript:c_oaynL66jY@14:55 ("cows do not need a drop off point")

mechanics.summary: Tower House: 175 wood, 60 s, Dark Age, +15 population, trains Highland Cattle. A House is 50 wood for +10.

Mustering Hall (Feudal, 50 wood, 15 s). Musters spend food plus one muster charge; each muster type can be used once. A muster is a 5 s action; afterwards the warriors come out one at a time, 2 s apart (the mustered unit records' train time). 1 charge by default; Influence tiers at 3/6/10 military production buildings each add a charge; tier 2 cuts muster cost 20%, tier 3 a further 20% (40% total, added) and gives non-naval mustered units +20% health. Three Loch Lookout adds 3 charges and +75% warriors.

evidence: observation:c_oaynL66jY@25:24 (Stew Ponds completed -> free Kirkman 90/90 HP)

mechanics.summary: A Kirkman builds a Fishpond (6 s, no cost) and works it for 40 gold per minute; while worked, nearby workers gather 10% faster (20% with Stew Ponds). Fishpond capacity: 1 per Lowland landmark (up to 4).
evidence: jeando17:upgrade_lowland_tier2_sco#description ("Increases Fishpond capacity by 1 and increases gather rates of workers near Fishponds from 10% to 20%. Instantly spawns a free Kirkman.")
transcript:c_oaynL66jY@9:12 ("It does not seem like it stacks"; Sam 2026-10-25: the buff does not stack)

unresolved.why: Records: the muster is a 5 s action and the mustered unit records train in 2 s. A real test game (BV182n46EEDi_p2 36:15-36:39) shows population rising by about one every 2 s after "Muster Border Reivers completed"; a cheat sandbox (qlogYcWhKEU 30:48) showed 18 arriving within about 2 s.
unresolved.fallback: One unit every 2 s after the 5 s action (the later arrival).

unresolved.item: Muster use: once per player or once per Mustering Hall
unresolved.why: Text says "Each type of muster is one-time use"; no footage shows a second hall mustering the same type (stream chat asked, unanswered).
The cheat sandbox started a 21-warrior muster with 18 free population and stopped at "Population Capacity Reached"; whether the rest wait or are lost is not shown.
unresolved.fallback: A muster starts only when its warriors fit under the population cap.

unresolved.item: Which structures count toward Mustering Hall Influence
unresolved.why: Barracks, Stable, Dock and Siege Workshop show "+1 Mustering Hall Structure"; Archery Range follows the record ("Generates influence to military production buildings"); Tower Houses carry no such line.
unresolved.fallback: Barracks, Archery Range, Stable, Siege Workshop and Dock count; all are placed inside the hall's influence.

unresolved.why: Relic income lives in state trees that the installed extraction does not decode (searched relic.rgd, monastery and deposit abilities); no 17.0 record or footage gives it.
unresolved.fallback: Plan parameter relicGoldPerMinute = 100 (the live-game Monastery relic rate as commonly shown in game; not verified from files).

unresolved.item: Relics on the map and walking time
unresolved.fallback: Plan parameters relics (3 collected) and relicDistanceTiles (45 tiles one way, walked at the Kirkman record speed 1.125 tiles/s).

unresolved.item: Cattle and villagers on the same bushes
unresolved.why: One cow per bush is stated; whether a grazing cow blocks villagers from that bush is not shown.
unresolved.fallback: Grazing does not block villagers; cattle can graze only on bushes not yet depleted (main patch plus far patches).

unresolved.item: Tower of Skye as a Tower House
unresolved.why: Text says it "Acts as a Tower House"; whether that includes +15 population is not shown.
unresolved.fallback: It trains Highland Cattle; no population.

unresolved.item: Wallace's Rally on the Archery Range
unresolved.why: Record modifier targets Barracks and Archery Range; text says infantry production.

unresolved.item: Stone of Destiny rebate reach and timing
unresolved.why: Rebate area is large but finite; the tooltip shows the rebate at placement.
unresolved.fallback: Every non-landmark building except farms finished after the Stone of Destiny completes is in reach; gold arrives on completion.

unresolved.why: Text: "Grants early access to Kirkman"; the producing building in Feudal is not shown.
unresolved.fallback: With the Stone of Destiny, Kirkmen (and Fishponds) are available from its completion; otherwise from the Castle Age Monastery.
